description: Participant identifier.
recommended_use: Grouping variable for subject-level clustering, random effects, and within-subject standardization.
notes: Primary unit for repeated-measures modeling.

description: Participant sex label as available in the source table.
recommended_use: Optional descriptive or exploratory covariate; do not overinterpret due to sample size.
notes: Check coding before any inferential use.

description: Participant age.
recommended_use: Optional descriptive or exploratory covariate.
notes: Use only if complete and reliable.

description: Functional run number.
recommended_use: Control variable for run-level effects and design checks.
notes: Regulation occurs only in run 3 and run 7.

description: Ordinal run index within subject.
source_or_derivation: Recomputed from run order within subject
recommended_use: Control for run-order, fatigue, habituation, or time-on-task effects.
notes: Usually identical to run for this dataset.

description: Trial index within each run.
source_or_derivation: Recomputed by sorting trials within subject and run
recommended_use: Control for within-run habituation or regulation fatigue.
valid_range_or_levels: Positive integers; passive runs have more trials than regulation runs.
notes: Use centered version for regression when possible.

description: Trial index across the whole experiment within subject.
source_or_derivation: Recomputed by sorting trials within subject across runs
recommended_use: Control for global time, experiment-wide habituation, or carry-over effects.
notes: Prefer global_trial_z_subject in regression.

description: Unique trial identifier.
source_or_derivation: Constructed as a unique subject/run/trial key
recommended_use: Merging behavior with imaging regressors or trial-wise outputs.
notes: Should be unique across the full file.

description: Original events file associated with the trial.
source_or_derivation: Source events file path or name
recommended_use: Traceability and audit trail.
notes: Useful when validating against raw BIDS events.

description: Trial condition label.
recommended_use: Primary categorical predictor for task validation and regulation analyses.
notes: Passive means no explicit regulation instruction, not necessarily absence of spontaneous regulation.

description: Indicator for explicit regulation trials.
recommended_use: Subset selection for regulation-only models.
notes: Equivalent to condition != passive.

description: Indicator for regulation runs.
recommended_use: QC and run-level filtering.
notes: In this design, regulation trials occur only in run 3 and run 7.

description: Regulation direction for regulation trials.
recommended_use: Regulation-only analyses.
notes: Use only after subsetting to is_reg_trial == 1 or handle missing explicitly.

description: Signed coding for up versus down trials.
recommended_use: Use only in regulation-only models comparing up and down.
notes: Coefficient represents half the up-minus-down difference under ±1 coding.

description: Ordered signed coding across all conditions.
recommended_use: Exploratory linear trend across down/passive/up; use with caution.
notes: Do not treat as the only condition representation if nonlinear condition effects are possible.

description: Indicator for up-regulation trials.
recommended_use: Categorical regression models with passive or down as reference.
notes: Use with condition_down and/or condition_passive depending on model intercept.

description: Indicator for down-regulation trials.
recommended_use: Categorical regression models with passive or up as reference.
notes: Use with condition_up and/or condition_passive depending on model intercept.

description: Indicator for passive trials.
recommended_use: Subsetting passive trials for baseline pain-encoding models.
notes: Passive trials are the preferred baseline for expected-pain models.

description: Regulation condition assigned to run 3 for the subject.
source_or_derivation: Derived from condition assignment in run 3
recommended_use: QC and order counterbalancing checks.
notes: Used to derive up_first.

description: Regulation condition assigned to run 7 for the subject.
source_or_derivation: Derived from condition assignment in run 7
recommended_use: QC and order counterbalancing checks.
notes: Should be opposite of run3_condition.

description: Indicator of regulation order.
recommended_use: Subject-level order covariate or descriptive QC.
valid_range_or_levels: 1 = up in run 3, down in run 7; 0 = down in run 3, up in run 7
notes: Avoid overinterpreting trial-level interactions with order because condition, run, and order are structurally coupled.

description: Text label for regulation order.
recommended_use: Plotting, summaries, and QC tables.
notes: Categorical version of up_first.

description: Indicator for passive runs with shifted/higher temperature context.
recommended_use: Sensitivity covariate for passive baseline models.
valid_range_or_levels: 1 = shifted passive context; 0 = standard passive context
notes: Useful because some passive runs were designed with a shifted temperature context.

description: Recorded stimulus intensity/temperature value.
recommended_use: Primary sensory input predictor.
notes: Treat as the recorded temperature/intensity variable unless separately verified against acquisition metadata.

description: Globally centered temperature value.
recommended_use: Regression models where a global intercept is meaningful.
notes: Does not remove between-subject differences.

description: Globally standardized temperature value.
recommended_use: Models requiring standardized coefficients across predictors.
notes: Use subject-wise version if focusing on within-subject effects.

description: Subject-centered temperature value.
recommended_use: Within-subject sensory encoding models.
notes: Recommended for within-subject pain-encoding estimates.

description: Subject-standardized temperature value.
recommended_use: Within-subject standardized modeling and effect-size comparisons.
notes: Mean approximately 0 and SD approximately 1 within each subject.

description: Raw recorded pain/warmth rating.
recommended_use: Primary raw outcome for transparent reporting and sensitivity analyses.
valid_range_or_levels: Numeric recorded scale, observed 0–200 in this file
notes: Do not describe as a strict 0–100 VAS unless verified; many values exceed 100.

description: Globally centered rating.
recommended_use: Regression models where a global intercept is meaningful.
notes: Keeps between-subject differences.

description: Globally standardized rating.
recommended_use: Standardized descriptive models across the full dataset.
notes: Subject-wise z-score is usually better for repeated-measures regulation models.

description: Subject-centered rating.
recommended_use: Within-subject models of pain reports.
notes: Removes subject-level rating offset.

description: Subject-standardized rating.
recommended_use: Recommended normalized outcome for group-level behavioral models.
notes: Mean approximately 0 and SD approximately 1 within each subject.

description: Rating rescaled to 0–1 within each subject.
recommended_use: Sensitivity analysis or visualization.
valid_range_or_levels: 0–1 within subject, if subject has nonzero rating range
notes: Less robust than z-scoring if extreme values exist.

description: Indicator that raw rating exceeds 100.
recommended_use: QC reporting and sensitivity analyses.
notes: High prevalence indicates this is not merely rare outlier contamination.

description: Subject-standardized rating from the previous input table.
source_or_derivation: Existing rating_z column from prior enriched table
recommended_use: QC comparison against recomputed rating_z_subject.
notes: Retained for audit trail; do not use as primary if rating_z_subject is available.

description: Difference between previous and recomputed subject-wise rating z-scores.
recommended_use: QC check for standardization consistency.
notes: Large values would indicate a mismatch in standardization.

description: Original/absolute stimulus onset as recorded in the source table.
recommended_use: Audit trail and recomputing run-relative timing.
notes: May be cumulative across runs in the source data; do not use directly for per-run fMRI GLM.

description: Stimulus onset relative to the start of the current run.
source_or_derivation: Corrected/recomputed from source timing and run boundaries
recommended_use: Primary stimulus onset for per-run fMRI event files.
notes: Use this, not stim_onset_abs, for run-level fMRI modeling.

description: Original/absolute rating onset as recorded in the source table.
recommended_use: Audit trail and recomputing run-relative rating timing.
notes: May be cumulative or otherwise not directly run-relative.

description: Previous rating-onset column that appears relative to the first stimulus in each run.
source_or_derivation: Existing timing column from prior enriched table
recommended_use: QC/provenance only.
notes: Not recommended as fMRI run-relative rating onset.

description: Delay between stimulus onset and rating onset.
recommended_use: QC of trial timing and recomputing rating_onset_runrel.
notes: Can vary slightly across trials.

description: Estimated absolute start time of the run.
recommended_use: Timing correction and QC.
notes: Used to derive true run-relative rating onset.

description: Rating onset relative to the start of the current run.
recommended_use: Primary rating onset for fMRI models that include rating-period regressors.
notes: Corrected version; preferred over the legacy first-stimulus-relative column.

description: Run-relative onset of the first stimulus in the run.
recommended_use: Timing QC and legacy timing reconciliation.
notes: Useful for checking whether older timing columns were first-stimulus-relative.

description: Rating onset relative to the first stimulus in the run, recomputed from corrected timing.
recommended_use: QC comparison to rating_onset_rel_first_stim_existing.
notes: Not the preferred onset for fMRI GLM.

description: Duration of the thermal stimulation period.
recommended_use: Event duration for stimulus regressors.
notes: Check for constancy across trials.

description: Duration of the rating period.
recommended_use: Event duration for rating-period regressors.
notes: Check for constancy across trials.

description: Stimulus offset relative to the start of the current run.
recommended_use: Timing QC and event-window definitions.
notes: Derived value.

description: Rating-period offset relative to the start of the current run.
recommended_use: Timing QC and event-window definitions.
notes: Derived value.

description: Globally centered run number.
recommended_use: Control for run-order effects in pooled models.
notes: In this balanced design, run_centered and run_centered_subject are typically equivalent.

description: Subject-centered run number.
recommended_use: Within-subject time/order covariate.
notes: Recommended when modeling within-subject temporal effects.

description: Centered trial index within run.
source_or_derivation: trial_in_run centered within subject/run or globally as prepared
recommended_use: Control for within-run habituation, fatigue, or regulation decay.
notes: Prefer this over raw trial_in_run in regression.

description: Standardized global trial position within subject.
recommended_use: Control for experiment-wide temporal effects.
notes: Can be correlated with run; check collinearity before combining with run covariates.

description: Temperature value on the immediately preceding trial within the same subject.
recommended_use: Modeling carry-over, adaptation, and sequential effects.
valid_range_or_levels: Numeric; missing for first trial per subject
notes: May cross run boundaries.

description: Raw rating on the immediately preceding trial within the same subject.
recommended_use: Modeling behavioral state and carry-over effects.
valid_range_or_levels: Numeric; missing for first trial per subject
notes: May cross run boundaries.

description: Subject-standardized rating on the immediately preceding trial within subject.
recommended_use: Preferred previous-rating predictor for within-subject models.
valid_range_or_levels: Numeric z-score; missing for first trial per subject
notes: May cross run boundaries.

description: Condition label on the immediately preceding trial within subject.
recommended_use: Sequential condition/carry-over analyses.
valid_range_or_levels: passive, up, down; missing for first trial per subject
notes: May cross run boundaries.

description: Run number of the immediately preceding trial within subject.
recommended_use: QC and identifying cross-run previous-trial cases.
valid_range_or_levels: 1–9; missing for first trial per subject
notes: Use same_run_as_prev to distinguish within-run from cross-run previous trials.

description: Indicator that the current trial has a preceding trial within subject.
source_or_derivation: Derived from whether a previous subject-level trial exists
recommended_use: Missingness handling for subject-level history predictors.
valid_range_or_levels: 1 = has previous trial; 0 = first trial for subject
notes: First trial per subject has no previous-trial history.

description: Indicator that previous subject-level trial occurred in the same run.
recommended_use: Separating within-run from cross-run carry-over effects.
valid_range_or_levels: 1 = previous trial in same run; 0 = different/no previous run
notes: Useful because breaks between runs may disrupt carry-over.

description: Temperature on the immediately preceding trial within the same run.
source_or_derivation: Previous trial's temperature within the same subject and run
recommended_use: Within-run adaptation and sequential sensory effects.
valid_range_or_levels: Numeric; missing for first trial of each run
notes: Does not cross run boundaries.

description: Raw rating on the immediately preceding trial within the same run.
source_or_derivation: Previous trial's rating_raw within the same subject and run
recommended_use: Within-run behavioral state and carry-over models.
valid_range_or_levels: Numeric; missing for first trial of each run
notes: Does not cross run boundaries.

description: Condition label on the immediately preceding trial within the same run.
source_or_derivation: Previous trial's condition within the same subject and run
recommended_use: Within-run sequential condition analyses.
valid_range_or_levels: passive, up, down; missing for first trial of each run
notes: In regulation runs, previous condition should match the run's regulation condition.

description: Run-relative stimulus onset of the previous within-run trial.
source_or_derivation: Previous trial's stim_onset_runrel within the same subject and run
recommended_use: Computing inter-trial intervals and timing-related carry-over.
valid_range_or_levels: Seconds; missing for first trial of each run
notes: Used to derive delta_prev_stim_withinrun.

description: Time elapsed since the previous stimulus onset within the same run.
recommended_use: Control for local temporal spacing and carry-over.
valid_range_or_levels: Seconds; missing for first trial of each run
notes: Equivalent to within-run stimulus-onset interval.

description: Indicator that the current trial has a previous trial within the same run.
source_or_derivation: Derived from whether a previous within-run trial exists
recommended_use: Missingness handling for within-run history predictors.
valid_range_or_levels: 1 = has previous within-run trial; 0 = first trial of run
notes: First trial of every subject/run has no within-run previous trial.

description: Previous raw rating expressed relative to the subject's mean rating.
recommended_use: Subject-centered previous-pain state predictor.
valid_range_or_levels: Numeric; missing for first trial per subject
notes: Useful alternative to prev_rating_z_subject when raw-unit interpretation is desired.

description: Previous temperature expressed relative to the subject's mean temperature.
recommended_use: Subject-centered previous-stimulus predictor.
valid_range_or_levels: Numeric; missing for first trial per subject
notes: Useful for carry-over models.

description: Indicator that rating_raw is missing.
recommended_use: QC and exclusion rules.
notes: Expected to be 0 for all rows in the cleaned file.

description: Indicator that temperature_raw is missing.
recommended_use: QC and exclusion rules.
notes: Expected to be 0 for all rows in the cleaned file.

description: Indicator that required timing information is missing.
recommended_use: QC and exclusion rules before fMRI event construction.
notes: Expected to be 0 for all rows in the cleaned file.
